[[Walsh Gymnasium]] |champion= Big East regular season co-champions |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2019–20 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team''' represented [[Seton Hall University]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They are led by tenth-year head coach [[Kevin Willard]]. The Pirates played their home games at the [[Prudential Center]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]] and [[Walsh Gymnasium]] in [[South Orange, New Jersey]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 21–9, 13–5 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]], which put them in a three-way tie for first place. As the No. 3 seed in the [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they were slated to play [[2019–20 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]] in the quarterfinals, but the Tournament was cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], along with the rest of the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA postseason]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Pirates]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 20–14, 9–9 in [[2018–19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a four-way tie for third place. In the [[2019 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2018–19 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the quarterfinals and [[2018–19 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]] in the semifinals before losing to [[2018–19 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] by two points in the final. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 10 seed in the Midwest region and were defeated by No. 7 seed [[2018–19 Wofford Terriers men's basketball team|Wofford]] in the first round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
